name: Wayne County Treasurer
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public waynecountymi.gov Treasurer pages (Internet Archive snapshots; the live site blocks automated clients); no sign-in, no lookup. The Wayne County Treasurer collects DELINQUENT property taxes under the Delinquent Tax Revolving Fund; current summer/winter taxes are paid to the local city or township treasurer (the mock still presents one tax bill). Online: search the parcel, Pay Now, ACH free, Visa/MasterCard/AmEx 2.49%; Wayne County mobile app; phone (313) 224-5990 option 1 (password created on first use); DivDat kiosks; mail P.O. Box 554889, Detroit, MI 48255-4889 with the barcode coupon, postmark by month end. Payment plans (REGSPA stipulated agreement 18%, DOOE hardship extension, IRSPA interest reduction to 6%) can be applied for online, so payment_arrangement is supported; veterans and first responders may enter plans with no down payment. Office by appointment only. No automatic payment or e-bill program is described (inferred unsupported; email reminders by request to taxinfo). Email sign-in is synthetic.

guest_pay.note: Search for your parcel and choose Pay Now: ACH from checking or savings is free; Visa, MasterCard and American Express cost 2.49%.

autopay.note: The Treasurer has no automatic payment program. Pay online, in the Wayne County app, by phone, at a kiosk or by mail; you can ask for email payment reminders.

paperless.note: Notices are mailed. To get email reminders about tax payments, email the Treasurer's office.

pay_by_phone.note: Call (313) 224-5990 and choose option 1; you create a password the first time.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check payable to Wayne County Treasurer with the barcode coupon to P.O. Box 554889, Detroit, MI 48255-4889.

payment_arrangement.note: Eligible owners can apply online for a Stipulated Payment Agreement, Distressed Owner/Occupant Extension or Interest Reduction Plan for delinquent taxes. Help: (313) 224-5990.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Online, search for your parcel and choose Pay Now. Paying by ACH from a checking or savings account is free; Visa, MasterCard and American Express cost a 2.49% service charge paid to the provider, not the Treasurer. The site may prefill an amount; you can replace it with the amount you want to pay. You can also pay in the free Wayne County mobile app.
By phone, call (313) 224-5990 and choose option 1; the first time, you create a password that saves your details. DivDat kiosks around metro Detroit take cash, check or card (cards 2.49%).

By mail, send a check payable to Wayne County Treasurer with the barcode coupon from one of your notices and your parcel ID to P.O. Box 554889, Detroit, MI 48255-4889. Payments postmarked by the last day of the month count as received that day. For a receipt, include a stamped self-addressed envelope or request one by email on the payment site.

help.title: Who collects your taxes
paragraphs: Current-year property taxes are paid to your city or township treasurer. Taxes left unpaid are turned over to the Wayne County Treasurer, which collects delinquent taxes for every community and school district in the county through the Delinquent Tax Revolving Fund.

The office at 400 Monroe Street, 5th Floor, Detroit is open by appointment only, mainly for required cash transactions; everyone else is encouraged to pay online, in the app, by phone or at a kiosk. Tax information line: (313) 224-5990.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: The Treasurer offers plans for delinquent taxes, and eligible taxpayers can apply online: the Stipulated Payment Agreement (REGSPA) sets a payment schedule that avoids foreclosure if kept, at 18% interest a year; the Distressed Owner/Occupant Extension (DOOE) is for owner-occupants with documented hardship; the Interest Reduction Plan (IRSPA) cuts the interest from 18% to 6% for eligible owner-occupants with a Principal Residence Exemption who keep current taxes paid.

Honorably discharged veterans, and police officers, firefighters and EMS workers who own property in the county, may enter a plan with no down payment. For help, call (313) 224-5990 or email the payment plans team.

extra.intent: Using the Wayne County Treasurer website's help pages, find the interest rate under the Interest Reduction Plan (IRSPA). Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The Interest Reduction Plan lowers the interest rate from 18% to 6%.
